data: Probability is the branch of mathematics that deals with the study of randomness. The study of probability provides a foundation to systematically explore processes in the natural and social worlds around us. In this course students will be introduced to the basics of probability theory including the underlying axioms, conditional probability and independence, random variables, and distributions. The course will also cover proofs of some of the classic results in probability theory, the Weak Law of Large Numbers, and the Markov and Chebyshev inequalities. At the end of this course, students will have an appreciation for using mathematical formalism in exploring randomness, and develop a basic set of tools to rigorously model phenomena with underlying uncertainty.
